stem:
Jhanvi cannot tell indicator colours apart clearly. Her teacher asks her to choose a way to test whether tamarind water and baking soda solution are acidic or basic using a change she can notice without relying on colour.

Which choice is best?

options.text: Use onion strips as an odour-based indicator and note how the smell changes in each liquid.
Use onion strips and conclude that the onion's smell change is what makes tamarind water acidic.
Use a strongly scented strip whose odour does not change in either liquid, because a strong smell alone is enough.
Use red litmus paper, because any coloured paper is the right tool when colour vision is difficult.

teacher.key_rationale: An olfactory indicator such as onion strips works when colour-based indicators do not.
